Please switch the status of the contribution to WIP, as there are a number of significant changes to make.

Formatting
* Please study the formatting syntax described on this page: https://www.codingame.com/playgrounds/40701/help-center/statement , and format your statement properly as described in the points below.

Goal
* Please format all characters used in the card notation as {{constants}} (e.g. {{S}}, {{1}} and {{S1}}).

* Please add a blank line below "K = King".

* The example without an explanation is essentially a duplication of the Example section. In addition, using so many repeating cards make it difficult to follow how the cards move. So,

  • Please use an example in which all cards are different (preferably all with distinct suits and ranks).

  • Please include enough intermediate steps to clearly demonstrate how the cards move. You don't necessarily need to show every step, but please show a reasonable number of intermediate states rather than only the starting and final states.

Input
* Please format "Line 1" and "Line 2" in <<bold>>.

* Please add "An integer" after "Line 1:".

* Please add "A string" after "Line 2:".

* Please add "dealing" before "order" to clarify what order this refers to.

Output
* Please add "A string" after "Line 1:".

* Please remove "[[D]]". The same variable name shouldn't be used to refer to both an input variable and an output value.

* Please change "the deck of [[N]] cards reordered" to "the initial order of the deck of [[N]] cards".

* Please change "played" to "dealt".

Constraints
* Please change 300 to 200, which is the maximum [[N]] used among the current test cases.

* Please add:
This puzzle uses a non-standard deck: cards may be repeated, and only the specified ranks are used.

Stub generator
* Please change "input" to "D" for consistency.

* Please change 500 to 200 for consistency.

Cases
* This is optional, but please consider changing the input and output format so that cards are separated by spaces, as this makes them easier to read. It's also somewhat confusing that spaces are used in the example but not in the actual test cases.

* Only Spades (Test 3) and Validator 3: The input [[N]] is 8 in both cases, but the length of [[D]] is 14 in both cases, which corresponds to 7 cards rather than 8. Please correct this inconsistency.

* Please remove the trailing newlines from the output for:
  • The whole deck (Test 4)
  • Validator 4

* A new example should have been used in the Goal section. Please use the same example for the first test case, and create a corresponding validator using a similar setup to form the first case pair.

* Please add new pairs of cases after the first pair, while keeping the case pairs generally ordered by the magnitude of N:

  • N = 1

  • N = 2

  • 100 < N < 200 and N is odd

Thanks.

Wow, thanks for that detailed review.
I think i was able to "adjust" everything you suggested except:

Stub generator
* Please change 500 to 200 for consistency.
=> If i would do so, the code would get wrong, as the length of the string is 2*N -> so i changed the stub to 400 not 200

Cases
* This is optional, but please consider changing the input and output format so that cards are separated by spaces, as this makes them easier to read. It's also somewhat confusing that spaces are used in the example but not in the actual test cases.
=> initially i wanted to add a testcase with 1000 cards, but the system seems to have trouble with a 2kByte string, so i reduced it to 200 cards = 400Byte. Adding a space would increase the string again, so i decided to not change.

If you do not have any further issues i would change state back to ready.
Thank you for your prompt follow-up. I'll review the puzzle later today and get back to you.

Goal
* The example is better than before, though the wording can still be clearer:

  • This results in the following dealt order => The following shows how the deck changes at each iteration

  • all instances of "Output" => Dealt order so far ("Output" could be confused with the output required by the puzzle.)

* Please also swap the order of "Output" and "Remaining deck" to match the order of the steps: a card is dealt first, and then the remaining deck is rearranged.

Output
* Please remove the word "reordered".

Stub generator
* My bad; you're right that 400 should be used instead of 200.

Cases
* Yes, outputs are limited to a maximum length of 1000 characters. Therefore, if the format is changed so that cards are separated by spaces, N would be limited to at most 333. This means you could still consider adding spaces to the existing cases, since the maximum N among the current cases is 200, which is still below that limit.

Thanks.

OK it was quite a mess to adjust all the testcases, but now the spaces are in, also i updated all your other suggestions thanks for pointing that out, it improves the quality of the listing and thats all that counts ;)

With this changes, is it ok now to switch back to ready ?
